description: What this service holds about ONE port, and how good the evidence is. Returns NGA World Port Index identity (UN/LOCODE, coordinates, harbour class, channel/anchorage/pier depths), the evidence grade for our movement data (origin = the authority publishes its own board / custody = a third party publishes it / measured = AIS inference only, asserted by nobody / none), what we do NOT hold, and what happened the last time we fetched the port's own website. Pass a port name, UN/LOCODE, or WPI port number as `query`.

query.description: Port name, UN/LOCODE (e.g. NZTRG), or WPI port number

name: shipping_port
